American Meals.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Tator Tot Casserole

ingredients.item: can condensed cream of chicken or cheddar cheese soup

American Meals.subtitle: Christina Meister
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Cook the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat until fully browned. Drain excess grease.
In a large bowl, combine the cream of chicken soup, sour cream, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits. Stir until smooth.
Add the cooked ground beef and frozen tater tots to the bowl. Mix until evenly coated.
Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

American Meals.name: Hawaiian Roll Sliders
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a skillet over medium heat, add the olive oil, onion, and salt. Cook until the onions are caramelized to your desired color.
In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, poppy seeds, garlic, and Worcestershire sauce.

Place the bottom halves of the Hawaiian rolls in the prepared pan. Layer with ham slices, caramelized onions, and cheese. Add the top halves of the rolls, then brush the poppy seed mixture evenly over the tops.
Bake for 10–12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tops are lightly golden.
Serve with the honey mustard dipping sauce (see recipe).

Asian Meals.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl

ingredients.item: ground chicken, turkey, beef, or pork

Asian Meals.subtitle: stylishcravings.com
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the sausage, stirring and crumbling until fully cooked through. Drain excess grease if necessary.
Stir in the garlic powder, ground ginger, and liquid aminos until well combined.
Add the coleslaw mix and cook until wilted to your desired tenderness.
Note: Do not add additional salt, as the liquid aminos provide sufficient seasoning.

Asian Meals.name: Garlic Chicken
Asian Meals.subtitle: thecookful.com
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the chicken with salt and pepper until fully cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, liquid aminos, sesame oil, honey, and cornstarch.
Reduce the heat to low and pour the garlic sauce over the chicken. Stir to coat, then add the water chestnuts and broccoli. Cook until the vegetables are tender.

In a separate skillet over medium heat, cook the cauliflower rice with the peas and carrots, seasoning with salt and pepper. Once heated through, push the rice to one side, add the eggs, scramble until cooked, then mix everything together.
Note: If using xanthan gum in the garlic sauce, start with a very small amount. Stir well and add more gradually if needed, as the sauce will thicken quickly.
Combine the garlic chicken mixture with the cauliflower rice. Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions before serving.

Asian Meals.name: Korean Beef
Asian Meals.subtitle: slowcookermeals.com
directions: Place the sliced flank steak and cornstarch in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal and shake until the steak is evenly coated. Transfer to the bottom of a 6-quart crockpot.

In a medium bowl, whisk together the sesame oil, garlic, fresh ginger, rice vinegar, liquid aminos, beef broth, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes until well combined. Pour the mixture over the flank steak.
Cover and cook on Low for 4–8 hours, or until the steak is tender.
Serve over rice and garnish with sliced green onions.

Asian Meals.name: ⭐ Teriyaki Chicken Crispy Rice
Asian Meals.subtitle: TikTok - @kalejunkie
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Rinse the rice under cold water 3–4 times, or until the water runs mostly clear. This helps remove excess starch and prevents stickiness.

In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, combine the rinsed rice and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to the lowest setting. Cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook for 12–15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat and let sit, covered, for 15–20 minutes.
Remove the lid and fluff with a fork. Allow the rice to cool completely, then transfer to a bowl and toss with toasted sesame oil and teriyaki sauce until well coated.

Spread the rice evenly onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes, stir, then bake for an additional 15 minutes. Continue baking, stirring every 10–15 minutes as needed, until the rice reaches your desired crispiness.
If using a rotisserie chicken, remove the meat from the bones, chop, and toss with teriyaki sauce. If using uncooked chicken, cook in a skillet until fully cooked, then coat with teriyaki sauce.
Add all dressing ingredients to a small blender and blend for about 1 minute, or until smooth.
Chop the cucumber, cabbage, cilantro, green onions, and peanuts. Place in a large bowl.
Add the chicken and crispy rice to the bowl and toss well. Drizzle with the desired amount of dressing and serve. Store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Asian Meals.subtitle: TikTok - @kalejunkie

Asian Meals.name: Thai Chicken Lettuce Wrap
Asian Meals.subtitle: thebusybaker.ca
directions: Add the ground chicken to a large skillet over medium heat and cook until browned and fully cooked through.
Stir in the liquid aminos, rice vinegar, brown sugar, peanut butter, and chili paste. Mix until well combined.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and water until fully dissolved.
Pour the cornstarch mixture into the skillet and stir continuously as the sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and spoon the chicken mixture into lettuce leaves. Garnish with chopped peanuts and sliced green onions before serving.

Italian Meals.name: Balls of Meat
directions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the ketchup, brown sugar, onion, liquid smoke, and garlic powder. Heat until the sugar is fully dissolved, stirring occasionally.
Place the meatballs in a crockpot and pour the sauce evenly over the top. Stir gently to coat.
Cook on High for 1 hour, or until the meatballs are heated through.

Italian Meals.name: Chicken Tetrazzini

ingredients.note: cooked & diced or 3-4 large cans of chicken

Italian Meals.subtitle: Stacy Thurm
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the butter, cooked chicken, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, salt, pepper, and broth. Mix until well blended, then fold in the cooked noodles.
Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish and spread the mixture evenly into the pan. Top with shredded cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

Italian Meals.name: Crockpot Meatballs
Italian Meals.subtitle: Brenda Scheetz
directions: In a crockpot set to Low, combine the BBQ sauce, butter, garlic salt, Mrs. Dash, brown sugar, beer, Tabasco sauce, whiskey, and habanero sauce. Stir until well blended.
Add the meatballs and stir to coat evenly. Cook on Low until the meatballs are heated through.

ingredients.note: 14 oz cans diced tomatoes with garlic and herbs - drained

Italian Meals.name: Million Dollar Spaghetti
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium pot, bring water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cream cheese, sour cream, and cottage cheese. Mix until smooth and well blended.

In a skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef. Add the salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and minced onion. Cook until thoroughly cooked, then drain excess grease. Stir in the spaghetti sauce and heat until warmed through.

Place a few slices of butter in the bottom of the prepared 9x13-inch dish. Layer half of the noodles over the butter, followed by half of the white sauce and half of the meat sauce. Repeat the layers.
Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and bake for 30–45 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.

Mediterranean Meals.name: Chicken Gyro Bowl
directions: In a large bowl, combine all marinade ingredients and whisk until well blended.
Place the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour the marinade over the chicken, seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
When ready to cook, remove the chicken from the marinade and gently pat off excess liquid.
Cook the chicken using one of the following methods: Grill: Cook over medium heat until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Bake: Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Skillet: Cook over medium-high heat for 15–20 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Once cooked, allow the chicken to rest for 5 minutes, then dice or slice into thin strips.
Divide the chicken evenly among 4 bowls. Top with diced red onion, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, feta cheese, and tzatziki sauce.
Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. Toss gently before serving.

Mexican Meals.name: ⭐ Birria Tacos
directions: In a Dutch oven, add the halved onion, tomatoes, garlic, ancho peppers, guajillo peppers, bay leaf, cinnamon, salt, half of the cumin, peppercorns, apple cider vinegar, and enough water to cover the ingredients. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-30 minutes, or until dark in color and fragrant.
Remove the bay leaf. Strain the mixture, reserving 1 cup of the liquid. Add the solids and reserved liquid to a blender and blend until smooth.
Line the bottom of a crockpot with sliced onions and place the 2" cubed chuck roast on top.
Mix Better Than Bouillon with ¾ cup water and pour over the roast.
Pour the blended mixture over the roast and sprinkle with cumin, taco seasoning, oregano, and garlic powder.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, or until the beef is tender and easily shreds.
Once cooked, remove the beef and shred. Strain the broth and transfer the consommé to a large bowl for dipping tortillas.
Dip tortillas in the consommé, then pan-fry on both sides until lightly crispy and golden.
Add Chihuahua cheese to one half of the tortilla and birria meat to the other half. Let the cheese melt.
Fold the tortilla in half and flip to crisp both sides. Remove from pan and top with cilantro, diced red onion, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.

Mexican Meals.name: ⭐ Elote Chicken Pasta
Mexican Meals.subtitle: TikTok - @ice.karmincooks
directions: Cook the chicken using one of the following methods: Grill: Cook over medium heat until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Bake: Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Skillet: Cook over medium-high heat for 15–20 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a skillet over medium-low heat, roast the sweet corn, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.
In a large bowl, combine the sour cream, mayonnaise, taco seasoning, Tajín, lime zest, lime juice, and honey (to taste). Mix until smooth.
Add the red onion, cilantro, cooked chicken, cooked pasta, roasted corn, and Cotija cheese. Toss until evenly combined.

Mexican Meals.name: Mexican Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut the bell peppers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds and membranes. Place on a microwave-safe plate and microwave for 5 minutes to soften.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

In a large skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef with the onions, garlic, taco seasoning, salt, and pepper. Once fully cooked, drain excess grease if needed. Add the beef broth, Rotel, and cauliflower rice. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

Arrange the peppers cut-side up in the prepared baking dish. Fill each with the taco meat mixture, top with shredded cheese, and bake for 20–30 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.

Soups.name: Chili
directions: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, brown the ground beef or pork with the diced onion until fully cooked. Drain excess grease if needed.
Add the Rotel, black beans, kidney beans, chili powder, and beef stock. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20–30 minutes to allow the flavors to develop.

Soups.name: ⭐ French Onion Soup
Soups.subtitle: saltedmint.com
directions: In a Dutch oven, heat the butter and olive oil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add the sliced onions, thyme leaves, and bay leaf.
Cook the onions until deeply caramelized, stirring every 10 minutes to prevent sticking. This process can take up to 45 minutes but is essential for developing rich flavor.
Once the onions reach a deep caramel color, deglaze the pan with white wine. Increase heat to medium-high and bring to a boil, allowing the alcohol to cook off.
Add the beef broth and return the soup to a boil. Reduce heat to low and let simmer.
Ladle the soup into 4 oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with toasted baguette slices.
Divide the grated cheese evenly among the bowls, ensuring each has a generous amount on top.
Place the bowls in the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Optional – Toasted Baguette: Brush slices lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder and Italian seasoning. Toast in the oven until golden.

Soups.name: Potato Soup
Soups.subtitle: Oscar Cruz
directions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, cook the bacon until crispy. Remove from the pot and crumble once cooled.
Reserve 1 tablespoon of bacon grease in the pot. Add the onions and sauté until translucent.
Add the diced potatoes, chicken broth, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 12–15 minutes, or until the potatoes are fork-tender.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the milk, heavy cream, cheddar cheese, and sour cream. Cook until the cheese is fully melted and the soup is smooth.
Stir in the crumbled bacon and serve warm.

Soups.name: Taco Soup
Soups.subtitle: beyerbeware.net
directions: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, brown the meat with ½ tablespoon of taco seasoning until fully cooked. Drain excess grease.
Add the cream cheese, Rotel, drained and rinsed black beans, diced jalapeños or poblanos, and the remaining taco seasoning. Stir until combined.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with shredded cheese and fresh cilantro before serving.

Soups.name: Tortellini Soup
Soups.subtitle: TikTok - @heresyourbite
directions: In a Dutch oven over medium heat, add the olive oil, butter, onions, celery, carrots, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Sauté for 5–7 minutes, until fragrant and vegetables begin to soften.

Add the Italian sausage to the same pot and cook until browned. Create a space in the center of the pan and add the tomato paste. Let the tomato paste cook for about 1 minute before stirring it into the sausage mixture.
Deglaze the pan with white wine and cook for about 2 minutes. Add the tomatoes, chicken stock, bay leaf, and Parmesan rind. Simmer uncovered for about 30 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf and Parmesan rind. Add the spinach and tortellini and cook for 3–4 minutes, then stir in the heavy cream.

Soups.name: White Chicken Chili

ingredients.item: Optional: shredded white cheddar cheese, cilantro, tortilla chips, avocado or sliced jalapeños

Soups.subtitle: Teresa Scheeler
directions: In a Dutch oven, sauté the chicken, onions, garlic powder, and olive oil until the chicken is fully cooked.
Stir in the northern beans, chicken broth, green chilies, salt, cumin, oregano, black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the sour cream and heavy whipping cream.
Optional: Garnish with shredded white cheddar cheese, cilantro, tortilla chips, avocado or sliced jalapeños.
